**I'd rate "Ship mobile offline mode" At Risk, and it will tip to Unhealthy if nothing finishes in the next few days.** I haven't logged this. The objective has no health check at all, so nobody has formally assessed it.

- **Time against progress:** about 19 of 40 days have gone (roughly 48%), but only 20% of the work is done.
- **Throughput:** all 3 completed stories finished by Oct 7, and nothing has finished in the 10 days since.

prompt: How has Falcon (FALC) been doing on velocity and say/do over its recent sprints? I'm trying to decide how much to commit for next sprint.
final_text:
Falcon sizes in story points. These figures cover its last 6 standard sprints. Sprint 2026.23 was an IP sprint, so it's excluded.

**Per sprint (newest first)**

| Sprint | Velocity (pts) | Items done | Say/do (pts) | Predictability (pts) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026.24 (Sep 30 – Oct 13) | 34 | 11 | 85% | 95% |
| 2026.22 (Sep 2 – Sep 15) | 27 | 9 | 66% | 78% |
| 2026.21 (Aug 19 – Sep 1) | 38 | 12 | 92% | 100% |
| 2026.20 (Aug 5 – Aug 18) | 21 | 8 | 57% | 65% |
| 2026.19 (Jul 22 – Aug 4) | 31 | 10 | 80% | 89% |
| 2026.18 (Jul 8 – Jul 21) | 40 | 13 | 94% | 100% |

**Summary (points)**
- **Velocity:** average 31.8, range 21–40, standard deviation 6.5.
- **Say/do:** average 79%, range 57–94%, standard deviation 13 points.
- **Predictability:** average 88%.

**What I'd read from it**
- Velocity is noisy but centered around 32. The last sprint (34) was slightly above average and the best since 2026.21.
- The team overcommits more often than not. Say/do has been below 80% in three of six sprints. The two weakest sprints (2026.20 at 57%, 2026.22 at 66%) were the ones where velocity fell to 21 and 27.
- Sprints that finished near their commitment, like 2026.18 and 2026.21, were also the highest-velocity ones.

**Suggested commitment for next sprint:** about 30–34 points. Anchoring on the 32-point average is safer than anchoring on the 40-point peak. If you want a conservative plan with a good chance of finishing everything, go nearer 28–30. That sits around the low end of the typical range and covers the dips to 21 and 27. In 2026.24 the team completed 85% of what it committed, so a commitment around 35 would be a stretch.

Two caveats. The sample is only six sprints, and the swings are large. I also can't see what's different about next sprint, such as holidays, PTO or carry-over, so adjust for those. If you tell me about them, I can refine the number.
